scripts.test: node --test scripts/native-conformance-gates.test.mjs && node --test packages/protocol/test/*.test.ts packages/client/test/*.test.ts apps/terminal/test/*.test.ts && node --import ./apps/terminal/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --test apps/web/test/markdown.test.tsx
